The steps the speed filter tests

Source: R/filter_speed.R
speed_steps.Rd

Returns one row per step between consecutive detections of one animal, with the distance between the deployments that heard them and the speed the step implies. These are the steps filter_speed() tests, positioned in the same way: each detection takes the position of the deployment of its receiver in the water at the time. Plot speed_ms against dist_m with the two settings drawn on before you choose them.

Usage

speed_steps(x, max_speed_ms = NULL, min_dist_m = NULL)

Arguments

x

A detset().

max_speed_ms, min_dist_m

Optional settings of filter_speed(). Given together, they add the column violation: the steps the filter would treat as violations in its first pass.

Value

A data frame: animal_id, from and datetime (the times of the two detections, UTC), from_station and station_id, dist_m

(great-circle distance, metres), secs and speed_ms (Inf for two stations apart at one moment; 0 within one position). Detections with no animal or no deployment position take no part, as in the filter.

See also

filter_speed()

Examples

study <- detqc_example
dets <- detset(study$detections, study$deployments, study$animals)
steps <- speed_steps(dets, max_speed_ms = 3, min_dist_m = 2000)
sum(steps$violation)
#> [1] 0
